/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
[web]
{
parm(in:&Mode, in:&ProductNumber);

ProductNumber = &ProductNumber if not &ProductNumber.IsEmpty();
noaccept(ProductNumber) if not &ProductNumber.IsEmpty();
noprompt(ProductNumber);

}

LoadAuditProduct.Call(!'Y', &AuditingObject, ProductNumber, &Mode) on beforeUpdate;
LoadAuditProduct.Call(!'Y', &AuditingObject, ProductNumber, &Mode) on beforeDelete;
LoadAuditProduct.Call(!'N', &AuditingObject, ProductNumber, &Mode) If Insert on BeforeComplete;
LoadAuditProduct.Call(!'N', &AuditingObject, ProductNumber, &Mode) If Update on BeforeComplete;
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== Procedure: DB.LoadAuditProduct ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

If &SaveOldValues = !'Y'
	If &ActualMode = TrnMode.Delete or &ActualMode = TrnMode.Update
		Do 'LoadOldValues'
	EndIf
Else
	Do 'LoadNewValues'
EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'LoadOldValues'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For Each Product
		Where ProductNumber = &ProductNumber
		&AuditingObject = new AuditingObject()
		&AuditingObject.Mode = &ActualMode

		&AuditingObjectRecordItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.TableName = !'Product'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Mode = &ActualMode
		&AuditingObject.Record.Add( &AuditingObjectRecordItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductNumber'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Producto'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = True
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = ProductNumber.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductDesc'

Sub 'LoadNewValues'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For Each Product
		Where ProductNumber = &ProductNumber
		If &ActualMode = TrnMode.Insert

			&AuditingObject = new AuditingObject()
			&AuditingObject.Mode = &ActualMode

			&AuditingObjectRecordItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.TableName = !'Product'
			&AuditingObject.Record.Add( &AuditingObjectRecordItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductNumber'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Producto'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = True
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ProductNumber.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductDesc'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Descripción'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = True
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ProductDesc.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductUnit'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Unit'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ProductUnit.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductCost'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Cost'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ProductCost.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductType'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Tipo Producto'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ProductType.ToString()

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'Packaging'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Packaging'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = Packaging.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'SubProductType'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Sub Product Type'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = SubProductType.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductExist'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Exist'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ProductExist.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductGroup'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Group'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ProductGroup.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductPiecesPlt'

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductPallets'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Product Pallets'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ProductPallets.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		EndIf
		If &ActualMode = TrnMode.Update
			For &AuditingObjectRecordItem in &AuditingObject.Record
					For &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem in &AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute
						Do Case
							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductNumber'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ProductNumber.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductDesc'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ProductDesc.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductUnit'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ProductUnit.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductCost'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ProductCost.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductType'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ProductType.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'Packaging'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = Packaging.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'SubProductType'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = SubProductType.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductExist'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ProductExist.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductGroup'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ProductGroup.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductPiecesPlt'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ProductPiecesPlt.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'Product8020'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = Product8020.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ProductPallets'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ProductPallets.ToString()

						EndCase
					EndFor
			EndFor
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub
